parts.text: Which rewritten division is equivalent and uses a counting-number divisor?
Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Multiply both 4.8 and 0.6 by 10 so the divisor becomes 6, a counting number; the quotient stays the same.

teacher.key_rationale: Scaling dividend and divisor by the same power of 10 leaves the quotient unchanged and makes the divisor a counting number: 4.8÷0.6 = 48÷6. B scales only the divisor. C scales only the dividend.
